ns2:section.sectionText: IB 199, Section AL1: Creationism, Intelligent Design, and the Nature of Scientific Evidence. 2 hours. Crosslisted with GEOL 199. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course. Students who enroll in more than one Discovery course may be dropped from the additional Discovery courses. For course descriptions, see the Discovery Program booklet. For a course listing of Discovery courses, see the front portion of this Class Schedule, Discovery, and Physical Sciences course.
